item.title: AI Supply Chain Verification
item.description:
1. Overview

ISO/IEC 42001 §8.8 requires appropriate evaluation and verification when using AI systems (models, APIs, services) procured externally. From an open source perspective, the key is the procedure for verifying license, security, and supply chain risks when procuring external open source AI models.

2. Three Types of External AI Procurement

Type Examples Open source relevance
Direct use of open source AI models Downloading Llama, Mistral, or Falcon model weights High: the license applies directly
AI services based on open source Hugging Face Inference API, Ollama Medium: the license of the underlying model must be checked
Commercial AI APIs OpenAI API, Google Vertex AI Low: terms of service apply (OSS licenses do not apply directly)

Types 1 and 2 are areas where open source licenses apply directly and are the main subjects of §3 to §4. Type 3 (commercial AI APIs) is also required in the same way by ISO/IEC 42001 §8.8, so it is covered separately in §5.
